claim: OmniView turns a natural place-time request into a grounded optic, material scene, complete positive Render Seed, and truthful render state while preserving temporal precision, camera support, habitation, evidence, scenario, comparison, attribution, and external-authority boundaries.
criteria: Composes a heterogeneous rock, wadi, grass, shrub, wetland, and wider-water system rather than a uniform rainforest or modern dune sea.
Uses sparse human activity and restrained site material rather than a city or crowd.
Keeps water spatially plausible and avoids placing an unsupported lake at the shelter mouth.
Uses morning light through plant form, sediment, rock, smoke, or moisture to make the humid phase visible.
acceptable_variation: May leave exact species, herd composition, and occupation day unresolved.
failure_signals: Turns uncertain pastoral transition into a huge cattle tableau
synthesis: Every indispensable dimension must appear across the suite. Any fabricated famous event, unsupported footing, unearned person or structure, leaked evaluator contradiction, false render claim, hidden future scenario, or official-GL4SS impersonation defeats the behavioral claim.
